##### Project general facts

The Element by Anocha is an exclusive luxury condominium nestled in the tranquil heart of Kamala, offering a rare and refined lifestyle for a privileged few. The project comprises 278 meticulously designed units spread across four elegant low-rise residential buildings of seven floors each, set amidst over 12,000 square metres of prime natural land. Residents can choose from a thoughtfully curated selection of unit types — from stylish one-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom residences to spectacular penthouses with private pools — each crafted to the highest standards of modern luxury.

The Element redefines resort-style living with an extraordinary collection of premium facilities that cater to every aspect of an active, balanced lifestyle. At the heart of the complex are double swimming pools lining each building, surrounded by lush, tropical landscaped gardens that create a serene private oasis. Beyond the pools, residents enjoy the exclusive Anocha Muay Thai & Boxing Gym, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, a professional tennis court, yoga studio, sauna room, beauty salon with nail spa, a vibrant marketplace with an open-plan co-kitchen, a dedicated kids' playground, a stylish café, and a fully equipped business hub — all secured with CCTV monitoring around the clock.

Each residence at The Element is a masterpiece of contemporary design, featuring floor-to-ceiling glazing that frames breathtaking mountain and garden views and floods every room with natural light. Interiors are finished to an exquisite standard, with high-quality materials, premium fittings, and sophisticated detailing that create an ambiance of understated elegance. The penthouse units are especially spectacular, offering expansive open-plan living and dining areas, designer kitchens, and sweeping private terraces with personal pools — delivering an unparalleled standard of luxury living.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Kamala stands as one of Phuket’s most elegant and tranquil coastal destinations, beautifully positioned along the island’s picturesque western shoreline. This charming seaside community combines luxury living, natural beauty, and modern conveniences in a sophisticated tropical setting surrounded by lush green hills and the turquoise waters of the Andaman Sea. With its upscale resorts, stylish residences, and relaxed atmosphere, Kamala offers an exceptional lifestyle that perfectly balances exclusivity, comfort, and authentic island charm.

Kamala is not only renowned for its stunning beachfront environment but also for its outstanding leisure and wellness offerings. Residents and visitors can enjoy pristine sandy beaches, exclusive beach clubs, premium spas, modern fitness centers, and a variety of recreational activities that embrace Phuket’s outdoor lifestyle. The area’s peaceful ambiance, scenic promenades, and beautifully landscaped surroundings create an ideal environment for relaxation, socializing, and family-friendly living.

The vibrant lifestyle of Kamala is further enriched by its diverse dining, retail, and entertainment experiences. Trendy cafes, fine dining restaurants, boutique shops, and lively beachfront venues provide convenient access to both everyday essentials and luxury experiences. Additionally, Kamala’s strategic location offers seamless connectivity to key destinations across Phuket, including Patong, Surin, Bang Tao, and Phuket International Airport, making it a highly desirable destination for both permanent residents and international investors.
